name: The system of Italian-style condominio theatres of the 18th and 19th centuries in Central Italy
description: Ten opera houses scattered across the small towns of Emilia-Romagna, Marche and Umbria show how Italians once built their own theatres. Dating from the mid-18th to late 19th centuries, they were funded jointly by town councils and local families, who owned the boxes like shares. Step inside and you find horseshoe-shaped tiers of boxes, grand foyers and original stage machinery, all set in the heart of historic town centres.
